title: A homework arrival never reopens intake a recruiter stopped
behaviour: In inviteToCase, when no open 'local' posting exists, the case's postings are read (listPostings(ws) filtered to the case) and classified by intakeOf (DevCaseDetail.publish.ts, the rule devcase-lifecycle/B introduced). state 'closed' (has postings, all closed: stop door or lifecycle close-out) -> refuse(entry, 'intake_stopped'): nothing published, nothing sent, logged, candidate stays in the Homework column for a human (the hook's existing refuse path). 'unpublished' (never published) and 'live' on another channel keep today's behaviour (publish/mint).
lock_strategy: re-check: the intake read runs after the hook's last await (the dynamic import of ./distribution) and immediately before adapter.publish, which reaches createPosting's IMMEDIATE transaction without yielding - no stop can interleave in-process. No db.transaction touched.
tests_added: app/_lib/stage-hooks-homework.test.ts: 'a STOPPED intake is not reopened by a homework arrival: the candidate waits for a human'
